summary: Measure IT emissions, improve cloud efficiency and build an ESG-aligned roadmap. Explore the course and strengthen your technology sustainability practice.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who make, govern or report technology-estate decisions and need to connect IT operations with sustainability evidence.
modules: IT Estate Sustainability and GHG Boundaries
Software Carbon Intensity and Data Lifecycle
IFRS S1 and S2 Technology Disclosures
IT Sustainability Roadmap and KPI Governance
prerequisites: Working familiarity with IT operations, cloud services, technology procurement or ESG reporting is recommended. No coding is required. A laptop with access to a spreadsheet application supports the footprint and roadmap exercises.
